verdict.rationale: Stable documents high-res scans of internal mail contents, not just envelope images, and its MailItem object exposes OCR result URLs, so opened-and-scanned content with text extraction is a documented capability. The evidence states no turnaround commitment and never says the output is a searchable PDF. Missing for 10: stated same/next-business-day scan turnaround SLA, explicit searchable-PDF output format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo
